releaseNotes: A provider running on your own machine can finally be reached: the app always accepted http for localhost, but the platform refused every cleartext request, so a local router such as 9Router never answered and the failure looked like a bad key. Cleartext is now permitted for localhost and 127.0.0.1 only. An empty reply and an unreachable provider are also named apart now, instead of both being blamed on the model.
